text:
sec-bot: Alert - KMS IAM anomaly detected for key projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/models/cryptoKeys/model-cmek. Member=allUsers, Role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter. High severity.

tanvi: on it. can someone confirm which resources use this CMEK?

leo: looks like the key was referenced by the model artifacts bucket and a bigquery dataset: gs://prod-models and bigquery:prod:ml_models. I see a terraform change merged yesterday that touched kms binding.

maria: confirmed — prod-models has CMEK=projects/prod/.../model-cmek. Access logs show an external IP downloading artifacts ~12h ago (still investigating).

sam: containment plan - remove the allUsers binding immediately, then audit access, rotate key material if any unauth activity. I'll run the remove now and post results.

sam: running: ```gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding model-cmek --location=global --keyring=models --project=prod --member='allUsers' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter'```

sam: command succeeded (policy updated). Please don't push any infra changes until we finish triage.

tanvi: nice, next step: list recent SetIamPolicy calls & crypto operations. Maria, can you run a logs query?

maria: running logging query now: ```resource.type="kms_crypto_key" AND protoPayload.methodName:("SetIamPolicy" OR "Encrypt" OR "Decrypt") AND timestamp >= "2026-03-19T00:00:00Z"```

maria: results: multiple Encrypt calls from a GCE VM with serviceAccount=ci-runner@prod. The SetIamPolicy adding allUsers shows actor=terraform@ci-bot (CI pipeline token).

leo: that matches — a CI pipeline incorrectly applied a legacy module with a permissive binding. We need to block that pipeline token and patch Terraform module.

ashley: opened INC-2347 for customer communications and tracking. I'll add the initial notification template. Tagging legal & trust.

infra-bot: (automated) created ticket INC-2347, linked runbook RB-ks-rotate, assigned to tanvi.

sam: containment checklist so far: 1) removed allUsers binding (done), 2) revoke CI token used by terraform (in progress), 3) rotate key if suspect compromise, 4) audit storage & compute artifacts pullers, 5) notify customers and legal.

tanvi: I'm going to disable new key versions from being created and schedule a rotation. For now we can create a new key and re-encrypt resources with it. Plan: create key model-cmek-2, update CMEK on buckets/datasets, then schedule old key for destruction after audit.

leo: terraform fix: add a linter rule and a guard in CI to prevent grant of allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers to cloudkms roles. I'll PR a module change and block the pipeline.

maria: audit findings so far: downloads from external IP were using an internal service account, appears to be legitimate job but I'm still verifying artifact integrity. No exfil timestamps after the binding was removed.

tanvi: action items (assign): tanvi - create and rotate to model-cmek-2 + re-key storage & bq (ETA 6h). leo - revert terraform change + PR guard + CI policy (ETA 2h). sam - revoke CI token and rotate any related keys/secrets (ETA 1h). ashley - incident ticket & customer/legal comms (ETA 3h). maria - finish logs audit and artifact integrity check (ETA 4h).

ashley: customer comm draft posted to INC-2347. Keeping wording limited: "We detected a misconfiguration where a KMS key had an overly permissive IAM binding. We've contained the issue and are rotating keys. No confirmed data compromise at this time." Legal reviewed.

infra-bot: automated policy suggestion: enforce organization policy constraint to disallow public IAM on KMS keys and deny public bindings in our terraform module registry.

tanvi: after rotation we'll run a full key usage review and rotate any wrapped secrets that used the key. Also will add an alert on any SetIamPolicy where member contains "allUsers" or "allAuthenticatedUsers" for KMS resources.

leo: quick command reference for other oncall folks: to check bindings: ```gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy model-cmek --location=global --keyring=models --project=prod``` to list versions: ```gcloud kms keys versions list --key model-cmek --location=global --keyring=models --project=prod```

sam: marking this incident as contained for now. We'll keep the thread updated as we rotate and finish audits. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Severity updated -> contained. Recommended post-incident: add automated terraform checks, org policy, add KMS public-binding alert, update runbook RB-ks-rotate.

(End of thread)
